fact: The ITU Digital Development Dashboard gives individuals using the Internet in Mali, total, at 33% for 2022 (ITU estimate); no age range is given for the total.
34 per cent of the population of Mali used the internet in 2021, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.
35.2 per cent of the population of Mali used the internet in 2022, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.
36 per cent of the population of Mali used the internet in 2023, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.
36.8 per cent of the population of Mali used the internet in 2024, an estimate by the International Telecommunication Union.
